messages.text: NBA season tips off as Detroit stage epic 22-point comeback to defeat Celtics

metadata.summary: Detriot Pistons staged an epic 23-0 run in the fourth quarter as they overcame a 22-point deficit - the largest come-from-behind win against the Boston Celtics in the last 30 seasons - to seal a stunning 121-113 win.
metadata.content: NBA: Detroit Pistons stage epic 22-point comeback to defeat Boston Celtics as season tips off in style | NBA News | Sky Sports Skip to main content NBA: Detroit Pistons stage epic 22-point comeback to defeat Boston Celtics as season tips off in style Detroit Pistons rally from 22-points down to beat Boston Celtics 121-113 with Javonte Green and Cade Cunningham’s 22 points and 8 assists winning the day at Little Caesars Arena Tuesday 20 October 2026 23:19, UK Image: Detroit Pistons guard Cade Cunningham (2) drives on Boston Celtics forward Jayson Tatum (0) in the NBA season tip off Detriot Pistons staged an epic 23-0 run in the fourth quarter as they overcame a 22-point deficit - the largest come-from-behind win against the Boston Celtics in the last 30 seasons - to seal a stunning 121-113 win. Javonte Green scored 19 points after not playing in the first half and Cade Cunningham finished with 22 points and eight assists, helping the Pistons to victory as the NBA season tipped off in style on Tuesday. Paul George scored 38 points, the most by a Celtic in his debut. The nine-time All-Star, in his 17th season, showed he's still got it in his first game with Boston since it acquired him from Philadelphia in exchange for 2024 NBA Finals MVP Jaylen Brown.
